cause.summary: The image installs mlflow==3.0.1; the tracking server is ghcr.io/mlflow/mlflow:v2.17.2. The 3.x client calls endpoints the 2.x server doesn't have.

static_check.rule: the MLflow client version differs from the server image's tag
